core_meaning.primary_meaning: Nazifa is an Arabic-origin name meaning “Clean, pure”.
core_meaning.literal_meaning: The name is the Arabic word itself, used unchanged as a given name rather than a derived or diminutive form.
core_meaning.meaning_explanation: Nazifa corresponds to the Arabic form نَظِيفَة (Arabic root ن ظ ف (n-ẓ-f); نَظِيفَة (Naẓīfa)). Its core sense is nazifa; clean, pure (feminine). Nazifa is Arabic نَظِيفَة (Naẓīfa) 'clean, pure' (feminine), from the root ن ظ ف (n-ẓ-f). CRITICAL SOURCE ERROR: the source gave نازفة (a different form); the correct form is نَظِيفَة. The source gloss 'Pure, Chaste' is broadly consistent.
